architectural-decision-records.why: records the per-skill-matrix design and the single-required-summary decision
architectural-decision-records.what: wrote ADR 0065: gate-matrix emitter + run-manifest-gates --only + a manifest-driven matrix workflow with a needs-all summary as the single required check (drift-proof); consumer runs each gate discrimination test
quotes: Every architecturally significant change ships with an ADR in the same unit of work

pattern-selector.why: chose the workflow structure deliberately against the forces, naming the rejected option
pattern-selector.what: selected a matrix of per-gate jobs plus a needs-all summary job as THE single required check, over making each per-gate job a required check (which would reintroduce branch-protection drift on every gate change); recorded in the ADR
quotes: A pattern removes one specific kind of failure or rot

verifiable-quality-gates.why: every new piece has a discriminating test that fails when it is neutralized or absent
verifiable-quality-gates.what: gate-matrix fails closed on bad/empty/duplicate manifest (never an empty matrix that looks green); --only runs one gate and fails closed on an unknown id; CONSUMER-TESTS now runs all 11 travelling-gate tests in a bootstrapped consumer
quotes: replace each check with a no-op and require its test to fail

comprehensive-test-strategy.why: tested at unit level and end-to-end through genesis into a consumer
comprehensive-test-strategy.what: unit tests for the emitter and --only; the genesis integration path confirms gate-matrix is copied, emits the ids, --only runs one gate, and the scaffolded workflow carries the matrix + summary, all in a real consumer
quotes: Test at the lowest level that can catch the bug

judge-arch.why: edited judge-arch own machinery (the aggregator) and reviewed the change in fresh context
judge-arch.what: added --only to run-manifest-gates reusing every per-gate safeguard; ran a fresh-context judge-arch review and recorded it in the arch-review log
quotes: These are not optional and not left to discretion

arch-encode.why: a caught coverage gap became an enforced meta-test rule
arch-encode.what: the workflow runs all 11 gate tests in a consumer, but the CONSUMER-TESTS meta-test covered only 10 (missing manifest-provenance); added it so upstream CI proves every travelling-gate test runs green in a consumer
quotes: A rule you can check mechanically is the goal

bdd-comprehensive-testing.why: coupling fires on the machinery/gate-script change; the behaviors are pinned as executable scenarios
bdd-comprehensive-testing.what: the behaviors (emit the ids, fail closed on an empty/bad manifest, run one gate by id, fail closed on an unknown id) are written as discriminating tests at the lowest layer that proves them
quotes: These are not optional and not left to judgment. Every time this

skeptical-audit.why: each claim carries an evidence state and re-runnable source, disconfirming case first
skeptical-audit.what: proved the matrix end to end in a genesised consumer (gate-matrix emits 11 ids, --only runs a single gate green) rather than asserting the workflow works; full suite + upstream-integrity + arch gate observed green
quotes: If you cannot attach all three, you do not assert it

enterprise-architecture-standards.why: no product system/data architecture change; this is CI workflow structure + manifest machinery, reviewed under judge-arch and pattern-selector

owasp-secure-coding-bdd.why: no auth/input/crypto/session code; the aggregator spawns gates with no shell, unchanged here

release-deployment-safety.why: no deploy/migration/feature flag; the workflow is CI structure, manifest version already leads at unreleased 1.2.0

sre-operational-readiness.why: no runtime service, SLI/SLO, or alerting surface

compliance-data-lifecycle.why: no personal data, retention, or schema/data migration

universal-accessibility-wcag.why: no user-facing UI; machinery, workflow template, and tests only

usability-ux-universal-design.why: no user-facing UI or workflow for people
